correctness.rationale: Direct piecewise B-spline integration independently recovered Gram entries g0=11/20,g±1=13/60,g±2=1/120, with strictly positive symbol (cos²θ+13cosθ+16)/30≥2/15. Quartic Q=z⁴+26z³+66z²+26z+1 has two distinct interior negative roots r,s, and Laurent inverse coefficients A r^{|k|}+C s^{|k|}, verifying infinite-mode decomposition by contour residues. Substituting the three nonzero translates on each side gives exact two-mode formula on y=m+t for m≥3. F_r(x) has exactly one zero in (0,1) at (sqrt(−r)−r)/(1−r), F_s there nonzero; max |Phi_z|=(1+z)/2. Uniform-in-t limiting supremum and the exact exceptional formula follow. Independent 36 kernel evaluations agreed to numerical precision. The theorem is one-sided and pointwise fixed x: no two-sided or arbitrary-knot statement.
